description: Lesson i2 mistake: hal-button-exti without HAL_NVIC_EnableIRQ(EXTI15_10_IRQn) - the EXTI line is pending but the interrupt never runs
expect: 72 MHz, like hal-button-exti (PB12 input pull-up + EXTI12 falling, PA5 push-pull low, USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1) except that EXTI15_10_IRQn is never enabled in the NVIC: a press sets EXTI_PR.PR12 but EXTI15_10_IRQHandler never runs, so no press is ever accepted - PA5 stays low and USART1 stays silent however often PB12 is pulled low.

circuit: PB12: push-button to GND, no external resistor
USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)

scenarios.name: two clean presses are never seen
